messages:
Alice Park: Heads-up — ScaleBench webinar next Wed 10:00am PT. Need final reg page, Zoom config, and clear post-event routing. Who can own what?
Omar Reyes: I can own the registration page. Will update CTAs and add the consent checkbox. Need final copy + hero image.
Priya Singh: Sending final copy in 30m. Include GDPR opt-in line and 'Request transcript' checkbox.
Sam Cho: I got Zoom ops. Plan: cloud recording (separate audio), enable alternative hosts for co-host failover, record gallery + shared screen. Anything to add?
Jenna Liu: Please enable live captions and recording SRT export. I'll own caption QA. We should also enable participant name display for clip owners.
Tom Ruiz: Lead routing note: HubSpot mapping as discussed — map utm_source/utm_campaign to original_source/utm_campaign, set Lifecycle Stage = lead for registrants, then convert to MQL on attendance. I'll build the workflow after reg form test.
Omar Reyes: Copy received from Priya — updating now. Quick question: Do we want a two-step reg (email+company) or just email?
Alice Park: Keep it one-step (email + company optional). Lower friction for PLG audience. Add a short privacy hovertext.
Sam Cho: Zoom settings I'll apply:
```
- Cloud recording: ON (record active speaker + shared screen)
- Audio: separate track
- Alternative host: sam.cho@redwood.com, jenna.liu@redwood.com
- Enable SRT for captions export
```
Sam Cho: Also setting co-host auto-assign after join to avoid host delay.
Jenna Liu: For captions: Otter.ai integration is fine. I'll run a short test tomorrow, capture SRT and plain transcript. Tag clips with speaker names afterwards.
Tom Ruiz: HubSpot mapping snippet for the workflow (will paste into the builder):
```
Trigger: Form submit (ScaleBench Webinar)
Actions:
- Create Contact if not exists
- Set property: original_source = {{utm_source}}
- Set property: utm_campaign = ScaleBench-Mar2026
- Add to list: "ScaleBench registrants"
- Send email: "Thanks for registering" (send immediately)
```
Tom Ruiz: Post-event: attendees -> tag "attended", send replay at +24h, non-attendees -> nurture sequence with clips at +48h.
Omar Reyes: I'll wire the reg page to send leads to the HubSpot form endpoint and attach hidden utm fields. Will test with sample submit.
Priya Singh: Draft of the confirmation email in thread: "Thanks for registering — link will be emailed 24 hours after event, recording + transcript available. Add to calendar attached." Thoughts?
Alice Park: Good. Make the CTA to request clips more prominent in the confirmation email.
Jenna Liu: Post-event handoff: I'll drop SRT + raw transcript into Google Drive, tag the clip owner (marketing-clip-ops). Expect artifacts by +6 hours post-event if recording uploads fine.
Sam Cho: Contingency: if cloud recording fails, set local recording to host laptop as fallback and enable RTMP as emergency. I'll bring a spare laptop to the runthrough.
calendar-bot: Event created: "ScaleBench: Production Inference at Scale" — Wed 10:00am PT — Zoom link added.
Alice Park: Action items recap: Omar = reg page + test, Priya = copy + confirmation email, Sam = Zoom config + runthrough, Jenna = captions + SRT handoff, Tom = HubSpot workflow + post-event sequences. Check-in tomorrow 11am PT. :thumbsup:
Omar Reyes: Starting tests now, will post results in this thread. :mag:
